subject: System Design
title: Zero Trust Architecture
description: A quick win: understand Zero Trust Architecture.

hook.text: A VPN gives access to the entire network. If an attacker gets VPN credentials, they can reach everything.

buildup.text: Zero Trust assumes no user or device is trusted, even inside the network. Every request is verified.

discovery.text: Access is granted per resource, per session, based on identity, device health, and context.

twist.text: Google's BeyondCorp replaced VPNs with Zero Trust. Employees access internal tools from any network.

climax.text: Zero Trust shifts security from the network perimeter to individual resource access.

punchline.text: Never trust, always verify — even on your own network.

quiz.question: What is the core principle of Zero Trust?
options: Never trust any user or device; always verify every request
